name: reel-pipeline
description: Headless Puppeteer + ffmpeg pipeline that drives the /3d page's ReelTimeline (see ../../src/three-page/ReelTimeline.js) frame-by-frame and stitches the captured frames into a vertical MP4. Separate tooling with its own dependencies - not part of the zero-build app deployed to GitHub Pages (see the repo root package.json's own description).
